intended_object: A canonical isomorphism of complexes: sheafifying the complex of presheaves n ↦ f_* I^n gives back the pushed-forward sheaf complex. Here I^• is the chosen injective resolution of G. Inferred from the docstring and its role in the RightDerivedPushforward construction.
explanation: This declaration is a proof-internal comparison isomorphism, not a mathematical notion. It is built component by component from Mathlib's `sheafificationNatIso`, the natural isomorphism saying that sheafifying a sheaf gives back that sheaf. Its naturality shows that the components commute with the differentials. The library uses it as an auxiliary step when relating complexes of presheaves and of sheaves in its construction of the right derived pushforward. It has no counterpart in the literature as a standalone object.
